chip.description: Main-CPU/sound-CPU communication chip: three latches on two decoupled buses plus a global volume control and per-channel mute for two channels; integrated into the 054544 and 054986A hybrid modules.
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/k054321.cpp in MAME 0.288, device full name "Konami 054321 Maincpu-Soundcpu interface" ("a sound communication latch/volume manager chip ... manages three latches ... and provides two independent busses"). Filed io per taxonomy Q11 (sound latches and inter-CPU mailboxes), matching the existing tc0140syt row; it generates no audio itself.
